narrative: CES40-1821B-0362 threw a DC ground fault alarm so I went out and isolated it down to CB-B03-06 where there was a home run chafed clean through against the rack upright. Repaired the run and got it resecured properly clear of the steel. The unit is back in service and the fault has not come back since. Firmware on this one is 5.0.4 which matches the rest of the block.
